assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Sodium hydroxide
items.clue: A common laboratory alkali, formula NaOH

items.label: Chemical reaction
items.clue: A change in which new substances are made.

items.label: Acid
items.clue: Has a pH below 7; cancelled out by an alkali.

questions.stem: In every chemical reaction, what happens to the atoms?

options.text: Some of them are used up and then destroyed
They are rearranged into new substances
Some change into atoms of other elements
They stay in the same molecules as before

questions.explanation: Yes. The atoms separate from the atoms they were joined to and join up in new ways, making new substances. No atom is made, destroyed or changed.

questions.stem: What does the formula CO₂ tell you about one molecule of carbon dioxide?

options.text: It has two carbon atoms and a single oxygen atom
It has two carbon atoms and two oxygen atoms
It has one carbon atom and two oxygen atoms
It has one carbon atom and one oxygen molecule

questions.explanation: The small 2 applies only to the O before it: one carbon atom joined to two oxygen atoms.

questions.stem: Sodium is a soft metal and chlorine is a poisonous gas. They react to make table salt. Why is salt so different from them?

options.text: Its atoms have changed into new elements
Its atoms are joined in a new arrangement
Its atoms are only mixed, not joined
Its poisonous atoms have all been destroyed

questions.explanation: A reaction rearranges atoms into a new substance, which has its own properties.

questions.stem: Iron reacts with sulfur to make a single product. Which word equation is correct?

options.text: iron + sulfur → iron sulfate
iron + sulfur → iron sulfide
iron sulfide → iron + sulfur
iron + sulfur = iron sulfide

questions.explanation: Yes. Iron and sulfur join to make iron sulfide. The reactants go on the left, the product on the right, and the arrow means 'reacts to make'.

questions.stem: A log burns on a fire and leaves only a small pile of ash. Where have most of the atoms from the log gone?

options.text: Into gases that spread out into the air
Into heat and light given out by the fire
Into nothing, as burning destroys them
Into the ash, packed far more tightly

questions.explanation: The atoms are rearranged into new substances, mostly carbon dioxide and water vapour, which escape.

questions.stem: Hydrogen (H₂) reacts with chlorine (Cl₂) to make hydrogen chloride (HCl). Which symbol equation is correct and balanced?

options.text: H₂ + Cl₂ → HCl
H₂ + Cl₂ → H₂Cl₂
H + Cl → HCl
H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl

questions.explanation: There are 2 H atoms and 2 Cl atoms on each side, and every formula is correct.

questions.stem: Hydrogen (H₂) reacts with oxygen (O₂) to make water (H₂O). What must happen to the H₂ and O₂ molecules?

options.text: They stay whole and stick to one another
They break up, and the atoms join in new ways
They cool down and condense to form a liquid
Their atoms each turn into atoms of water

questions.explanation: In a reaction the atoms in the reactants separate and join together differently to make the products.

questions.stem: In the equation 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, what does the large 2 in front of H₂O mean?

options.text: Two separate atoms of water are made
Each water molecule has two hydrogens
Two grams of water are made
Two molecules of water are made

questions.explanation: A large number in front of a formula shows how many of that molecule take part or are made.

questions.stem: A student mixes two colourless solutions. A yellow solid appears at once. What does this suggest?

options.text: One of the two solutions has frozen solid
A dissolved solid has reappeared unchanged
The atoms have each changed their colour
Atoms have rearranged to make a new substance

questions.explanation: A new solid with a new colour is a sign that atoms have rearranged into a new substance.

questions.stem: In a chemical equation, what does the arrow (→) mean?

options.text: The two sides are the same substances
The reactants change into the products
The reactants are mixed with the products
The reactants have to be heated strongly

questions.explanation: The arrow means 'react to make': reactants on the left change into products on the right.

questions.stem: Six carbon atoms react completely with six O₂ molecules to make carbon dioxide. Which atoms are in the carbon dioxide made?

options.text: 6 carbon atoms and 6 oxygen atoms
12 oxygen atoms and no carbon atoms
6 new atoms of carbon dioxide
6 carbon atoms and 12 oxygen atoms

questions.explanation: No atoms are made or destroyed: 6 C and 12 O atoms go in, so 6 C and 12 O atoms come out.

questions.stem: Magnesium (Mg) burns in oxygen (O₂) to make magnesium oxide (MgO). Which symbol equation is balanced and correct?

options.text: 2Mg + O₂ → Mg₂O₂
Mg + O₂ → 2MgO
2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO
Mg + O₂ → MgO + O

questions.explanation: Yes. Left: 2 Mg and 2 O. Right: 2MgO has 2 Mg and 2 O. The formulae are unchanged and every atom balances.
